entities.name: MnmA (B0TQ02)
observations: Exact 371-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt B0TQ02 from Shewanella halifaxensis; annotated as tRNA-specific 2-thiouridylase.
Catalyzes 2-thiolation of wobble-position U34 in tRNA, forming s(2)U34.
Annotated cytoplasmic; GO:0005737 cytoplasm, GO:0103016 tRNA-uridine 2-sulfurtransferase activity, GO:0002143 tRNA wobble position uridine thiolation.

entities.name: tRNA U34 thiolation
observations: MnmA-mediated thiolation of wobble uridine U34 produces s(2)U34 and is annotated as tRNA wobble position uridine thiolation (GO:0002143).
